v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Qui hábitas in cælis, * miserére nobis.
text.en: Thou who dwellest in heaven, * have mercy on us.
Our help is * in the name of the Lord.

text.la: In circúitu pópuli sui * Dóminus, ex hoc nunc et usque in sǽculum.
text.en: The Lord standeth round his people * from this time forth and for evermore.

text.la: Magnificávit Dóminus * fácere nobíscum: facti sumus lætántes.
text.en: The Lord hath * done great things for us, whereof we rejoice.

text.la: Dóminus ædíficet * nobis domum, et custódiat civitátem.
text.en: The Lord builds * the house and keeps the city.

text.la: Fratres: Qui gloriátur, in Dómino gloriétur. Non enim qui seípsum comméndat, ille probátus est; sed quem Deus comméndat.
text.en: Brothers: But he that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord. For not he who commendeth himself, is approved, but he, whom God commendeth.

v.la: Diffúsa est grátia in lábiis tuis.
v.en: Grace is poured into thy lips.

r.la: Proptérea benedíxit te Deus in ætérnum.
r.en: Therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

text.la: Veni, Sponsa Christi, * áccipe corónam, quam tibi Dóminus præparávit in ætérnum.
text.en: Come, Bride of Christ, and take the everlasting crown * which the Lord hath prepared for thee.

text.la: Dómine, qui dixísti: Nisi efficiámini sicut párvuli, non intrábitis in regnum cælórum: da nobis, quǽsumus: ita sanctæ Terésiæ Vírginis in humilitáte et simplicitáte cordis vestígia sectári, ut prǽmia consequámur ætérna.
text.en: O Lord, who hast said: Unless you become as little children you shall not enter the kingdom of heaven, grant us, we pray, so to follow, in humility and simplicity of heart, the footsteps of the virgin blessed Theresa, that we may attain to an everlasting reward.

office.title: S. Theresiæ a Jesu Infante Virginis
